During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''pharmaceutical company''' sought to acquire a [[Unidentified banned flower|rare, widely-banned flower]] that could be dried, ground and ingested for medicinal purposes, and was believed to be found on [[Durace]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|An Unusual Bloom}}</ref>
